records.rule: No relationship sentinel. Per-field blank after approved normalization is optional absence; invalid nonblank is withheld. No global blank/zero rule.
No tuple-parent sentinel. Three blanks mean all-blank tuple; one/two populated means partial. Placeholder-looking content has no automatic sentinel meaning.
No mapped target is parent-not-released. Null/zero/guessed/current/first/admin/importer target identifiers and synthetic parents are prohibited.
Delegate fully to PATIENT-ALIAS-004..009 and PATIENT-REC-ALIAS-002; Phase 2D adds no sentinel/canonical rule.
Chain token has no sentinel/substitute. Missing or mismatched domain/key/canonicalization/snapshot version is privacy/provenance failure and holds every child.
